div.style: height: 100%; background: var(--fix-color-surface-canvas, #fafafa); overflow-y: auto; padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px);
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); margin-bottom: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px);

h1.style: margin: 0; font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-500, 20px); color: var(--fix-color-text-primary, #242424); flex: 1;

section.style: margin-bottom: var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); border: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-md, 8px); overflow: hidden;

div.style: display: flex; align-items: center; padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px) var(--fix-dimension-space-md, 16px); background: var(--fix-color-surface-secondary, #f5f5f5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fix-color-border-default, #e0e0e0); cursor: pointer;

span.style: font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-300, 14px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--fix-color-text-primary, #242424); flex: 1;
background: var(--fix-color-status-info-bg, #ebf8f6); color: var(--fix-color-status-info, #0e7a6e); font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--fix-dimension-border-radius-pill, 999px);

ul.style: margin: 0; padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-sm, 8px) var(--fix-dimension-space-lg, 24px); color: var(--fix-color-text-secondary, #616161); font-size: var(--fix-typography-size-200, 12px); list-style: none;

div.style: padding: var(--fix-dimension-space-xxl, 48px); text-align: center; color: var(--fix-color-text-ink-faint, #bdbdbd);
